learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn the magic trick to change one thing into many things!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: When we have only one thing it is called Singular like one cat. When we have more than one thing it is called Plural like two cats.
To make most words plural we just add a magic S at the end. Book becomes books and pen becomes pens!
Some tricky words need ES at the end to become many. Box becomes boxes and glass becomes glasses.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Draw One and Many
fun_activity.instructions: Draw one flower on the left side of your paper. Draw three flowers on the right side and write Flowers below them!

quick_recap: ⭐ Plural means more than one thing.
⭐ We add S or ES to make words plural.
